snippet.title: Fae & Fauna Teaser Trailer - 2023
snippet.description:
Introducing our captivating teaser trailer for Fae & Fauna, an extraordinary open-world pet-collecting role-playing game! Embark on an enchanting adventure as you explore uncharted territories, discovering awe-inspiring realms teeming with mystical creatures. Prepare to immerse yourself in a thrilling battle against perilous forces alongside your loyal companions, as you harness the power of friendship to triumph over the untamed wilderness!

Wishlist us on Steam to follow development:

Steam link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2363200/Fae__Fauna/

More info on our webpage: https://www.auroraartsstudio.com/

LinkTree: https://linktr.ee/auroraarts
